note: Role table for the peer channel. Identity = role, not session name / pid / thread title. Session names are auto-generated or change with /rename; pids get reused; none of them are stable identifiers. Edit cwd_match + entrypoints to match your own layout: `entrypoints` distinguishes a desktop CLI session ('cli') from a T3 Code thread ('t3-code').

desktop.describes: Desktop Claude Code CLI session in your repo. Ask it implementation details it owns.

mobile.describes: T3 Code thread (phone / web / desktop app) working in the same repo. Worktree threads run under <T3_HOME>/worktrees/<name>/<id>.
